title: Go/No-Go Checklist & Escalation Ladder for Security Certification Rollouts (SSO/SAML, Audit Logs, SOC2)
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Create a prescriptive go/no-go decision checklist, an escalation ladder, and an automated gating ruleset to be used for all enterprise security certification cutovers (SSO/SAML integrations, audit log retention/capture, SOC2 control completion). This ticket produces the canonical checklist artifact, integration test matrix, ownership RACI, and a rollback playbook that SRE/PM/Legal/Security sign off on before any enterprise cutover window.
